theorems.name: Submission.weight_closedBall_lower_bound_of_density_ge_one
theorems.statement: MonotonicityFormula → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ : ℝ) (θ : ℝ≥0∞), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → 0 < ρ₀ → ball x ρ₀ ⊆ U → 0 ≤ Λ → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * V.weight (closedBall x ρ)) → HasDensity n V.weight x θ → 1 ≤ θ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Λ * ρ))) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n ≤ V.weight (closedBall x ρ)
